create_random_rec_datamodule: create a RandomRecDataModule instance with custom batch size, hash size, and feature keys for recommendation data
build_train_dataloader: build a training dataloader from RandomRecDataModule that yields random batches of sparse and dense features
build_val_dataloader: build a validation dataloader from RandomRecDataModule that yields random batches of sparse and dense features
build_test_dataloader: build a test dataloader from RandomRecDataModule that yields random batches of sparse and dense features
register_hydra_config: register the RandomRecDataModuleConf dataclass with Hydra ConfigStore under the schema/datamodule group
